vulnerable_code:
class PortfolioChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    # BOLA: Streams live market orders and trade fills directly from client parameter
    # without checking if current_user owns the requested portfolio
    stream_from "portfolio_#{params[:portfolio_id]}"
  end

  def unsubscribed
    stop_all_streams
  end
end
diagnosis: The PortfolioChannel subscribed action binds real-time trade execution streams solely based on params[:portfolio_id]. An authenticated investor can connect to competing accounts' private portfolio streams to intercept high-value order fills and sensitive balance updates.
corrected_code:
class PortfolioChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    portfolio = current_user.portfolios.find_by(id: params[:portfolio_id])
    reject unless portfolio

    stream_from "portfolio_#{portfolio.id}"
  end

  def unsubscribed
    stop_all_streams
  end
end
